rows.title: Aromatherapy with lavender essential oil for the control of dental anxiety in patients undergoing dental surgery: A triple-blind randomized clinical trial.
rows.focus: Triple-blind randomized clinical trial of lavender aromatherapy during dental surgery found lower post-intervention respiratory rate, heart rate, cortisol, and local anesthetic use versus control; baseline dental-anxiety scores were similar.

rows.title: Decoding kratom: molecular mechanisms and epigenetic factors in use and dependence.
rows.focus: Systematic review of preclinical kratom evidence mapped receptor, intracellular-signaling, gene-regulation, withdrawal-associated, cardiac-ion-channel, and CYP-related findings. The review emphasizes limited pharmacokinetic standardization and insufficient long-term human safety evidence.

rows.title: Safety and Tolerability of Single and Multiple Daily Oral Doses of Dried Kratom Leaf Powder in a Randomized Trial in Healthy Volunteers.
rows.focus: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled human kratom-administration study evaluated treatment-emergent adverse events, tolerability, abuse-potential signals, and withdrawal during follow-up. Adverse events increased with exposure, but no serious adverse events or deaths were reported in the studied healthy-volunteer sample.
